quest.title: Fishing Jiangxue
quest.description: Jiangxue is fishing by himself, but it seems like he's waiting for something to happen...

dialogues.speaker: Jiangxue
dialogues.text: I hope I catch something eventually...

dialogues.speaker: Jiangxue
dialogues.text: Preparing to reel in the biggest catch you've ever seen!

dialogues.speaker: Jiangxue
dialogues.text: I have a friend who enjoys cooking. If I catch a nice big fish for him, I bet it'll make him happy.

dialogues.speaker: Jiangxue
dialogues.text: The only thing is, monsters keep stirring up trouble here, which disturbs the fish.

dialogues.speaker: Jiangxue
dialogues.text: I sense strong elemental power in you. Would you be willing to deal with the monsters for me, so I can finally catch that fish?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But how do you know when the monsters will get here?

response.speaker: Jiangxue
response.text: Seeing is believing. Look out behind you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hah! That's the oldest trick in the book—

response.speaker: Jiangxue
response.text: I once had a Vision, too. I don't bother using it anymore, but I can still sense elemental power when I want to.

response.speaker: Jiangxue
response.text: With the power of the elements on your side, these monsters should be a piece of cake for you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yikes! Where did they all come from!? This just makes no sense...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You... you got them! But Paimon didn't see you lift a finger...

dialogues.speaker: Jiangxue
dialogues.text: You're right, it doesn't. Lots of things in this world don't add up.

dialogues.speaker: Jiangxue
dialogues.text: The chef from the inn, for example. He used to be a sword fighter, now he loves to cook. He's stony-faced but has a heart of gold.

dialogues.speaker: Jiangxue
dialogues.text: And the boss. She's a Mondstadter, but nobody from Mondstadt knows her.

dialogues.speaker: Jiangxue
dialogues.text: And... you. You don't have a Vision, yet you can still use elemental power.

dialogues.speaker: Jiangxue
dialogues.text: Some things don't add up, but that doesn't always mean they are to be feared.

dialogues.speaker: Jiangxue
dialogues.text: Take these as a token of my thanks. I want to carry on fishing now.
